messages:
leo: quick heads-up — Nimbus Health demo blocked. model output sometimes includes HTML-escaped angle brackets inside strings and then appends a short human note after the JSON. strict json_mode parser fails, customer can't ingest results.
priya: can you paste the raw response and the exact request body you sent (redact PHI)?
leo: redacted raw (copied verbatim):
```
{"response":"{\"diagnosis\":\"follow-up: <b>labs normal</b>\",\"status\":\"ok\"}NOTE: verified by clinician"}
```
mike: that's two issues: escaped HTML entities inside the string, and extra trailing text AFTER the JSON closing brace. strict json_mode will choke.
keegan: what SDK/call? streaming? function_call?
leo: JS SDK, chat endpoint, streaming off, no function_call. request body:```json
{"model":"redwood-open-2","json_mode":"strict","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"diagnosis":{"type":"string"},"status":{"type":"string"}},"required":["diagnosis","status"]},"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize patient note"}]}
```
priya: short unblock options: 1) set json_mode to "relaxed" which will try to extract the first JSON object and ignore trailing commentary, or 2) pre-parse on the client: find first balanced brace pair and JSON.parse that substring, then html-unescape string values.
mike: note on costs: relaxed parsing and extra attempts add CPU and token postprocessing — call it out to sales for potential unit-cost impact. could matter for high-volume POCs.
keegan: engineering plan: add server-side tolerant extractor as a pre-parse step that returns the first balanced JSON object; also run an HTML-unescape pass for tokens only during parsing (do NOT store unescaped). will log occurrences with model/temperature so we can see correlation.
security-bot: security note: unescaping for parser is fine if you never render escaped content directly; ensure downstream renderers sanitize to prevent XSS. redact PHI before posting.
leo: all redacted here. thanks.
deploy-bot: quick patch created: PR #4321. proposes: 1) tolerant extractor, 2) token-level html unescape during parse, 3) telemetry counter. canary target: 1777779000, roll size 1%.
priya: can we give Nimbus a one-paragraph customer note to unblock demo pls?
mike: draft for customer: "Mitigation: As a temporary measure, you can set json_mode=\"relaxed\" or run a small client-side pre-parse that extracts the first JSON object and HTML-unescapes string fields before parsing. We will deploy a server-side tolerant extractor and parser in the next minor release (ETA: 72 hours)."
keegan: also adding a console warning badge when trailing text detected so users see occurrences.
leo: perfect. i'll send the note and demo workarounds.
priya: follow-up: add a sales-facing note about potential small unit-cost increase when using relaxed mode so AE knows to surface it.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled at 1777779000, will post results here.
leo: thanks all 8am demo saved	:thumbsup:
